params.body:
Two tests failed on runs that changed nothing they cover, both on the clock.

- `HandsReadWithTheirKeyTest` signed the stale and future `iat` at `time()` minus or plus 121 seconds, against a window of 120 (`HandSignature::CLOCK_SKEW`). When the request reached the check one second later, the skew was exactly 120 and the request was accepted (main after #414). Both cases now sit a minute past the edge, written in terms of the constant.
- `AppApiTest::test_a_working_set_admits_its_own_and_names_the_rest` made the working set with `now()->addDays(5)` and built the expected sentence from a second `now()->addDays(5)`. When a minute turned between the two, it read 08:13 against 08:14 (#415). The end is now read once and used for the set and both assertions.

Replaces #415, which carries only the first fix; the gateway cannot push to an existing branch.
